note: Nauru issues no national identity card: the birth certificate is its officially recognised legal identity, and a national identification system has not yet been established, though legislation for individual national ID codes passed in 2017 (SEAP digital ID overview).

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Nauru
sources.said: The officially recognized legal identity in Nauru is a birth certificate. ... A national identification system has not yet been established, though legislation for the implementation of individual national ID codes was passed in 2017.
